description: For punch list, this checklist records observed deficiency, acceptance criterion, access need, correction owner, due date, and predecessor dependency. Its supporting evidence includes dated photo, test reading, inspection note, drawing reference, and reinspection result.

blocks.guidance: Link this punch list record to its evidence.
blocks.label: Punch List Record and Routing

blocks.guidance: Capture room or grid location, system, responsible trade, contract reference, and turnover milestone for this punch list.

items: Correct checklist version and applicability are confirmed

subtitle: Punch List Checklist: deficiency capture, assignment, and verification using room or grid location, observed deficiency, and dated photo.
title: Punch List Checklist
use_case: Use the checklist during deficiency capture, assignment, and verification when the punch list record must identify room or grid location, system, responsible trade, contract reference, and turnover milestone. Complete the applicable handoff for verified correction, owner acceptance, exception disposition, remaining-list reconciliation, and turnover handoff.
